VI.description: EXPERIMENT ONLY - the shipped close helper with the Save node REMOVED\2C so Close takes the project reference straight from Project\3AActive Project. Everything else is byte-identical to lvai_close_active_project.xml\2C including the Close Reference at uid 45 and the per-stage indicators\2C so an A/B against it isolates the Save and nothing else.\0A\0AWHY\3A a 33-minute class build logged 3 'bad parent in MoveItem' warnings\2C one per close\2C while four closes in a QUIET state logged none - which points at what LabVIEW holds in MEMORY rather than at the close's wiring. A project Save makes LabVIEW ADOPT every VI it has open as a loose project item\2C and 'bad parent in MoveItem' is a project-tree complaint\2C so the Save is the standing hypothesis.\0A\0ANOT FOR SHIPPING. Close carries no save parameter\2C so without the Save an unsaved project risks LabVIEW's MODAL save prompt - and a modal dialog stops the whole gRPC service until a human dismisses it.
